description: This Java source file defines a custom watch face service for Android Wear OS, specifically named 'CardBoundsWatchFaceService'. It implements functionality to visually indicate the position of a peek card by drawing borders around the peek area and filling it with color, supporting both ambient and interactive modes.

classes.name: CardBoundsWatchFaceService
classes.description: A service extending CanvasWatchFaceService that creates a custom watch face with visual indication of the peek card position.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine; handles rendering, style, and peek card position updates.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Engine class.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face style and logs creation.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes between ambient and active modes, triggering redraw.

methods.name: onPeekCardPositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates the position of the peek card and triggers a redraw if changed.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the watch face, drawing borders around the peek card and filling the area depending on the mode.
